summary: The candidate typechecks as Well-formed and HAMR successfully generated a runtime-monitored Microkit Rust projection with Verus attribute contracts for all five behavior Threads. Lifecycle semantics, contract ownership, eleven semantic interactions, and all accepted trace IDs are preserved; deployment support and a Boolean-literal compatibility normalization were added.

contract_changes.change: 38 equivalent spelling normalizations: T to true (5), F to false (33)
contract_changes.evidence: This source-boundary repair prevents unresolved bare identifiers in runtime GUMBOX output. No operator, guard, case, helper, state or output relation changed; HAMR generated two Verus attribute entrypoint contracts per application crate and eleven governor case markers.

deferred_items: Application implementation and Verus proof are recorded by the subsequent application stage.
Microkit provisioning/building and image execution were not run.

Current HAMR Microkit requires one Thread per Process, so the executable projection uses five behavior-free Process wrappers and 27 physical PortConnection declarations instead of the accepted abstract deployment's one wrapper and 17 declarations; this deployment-only difference is not claimed to satisfy that abstract structural metric.
